summary: Phase 2 adversarial re-audit at 36dec52e: Red's fix closes ADV-1 to ADV-3, and the Phase 2 gate holds against every probe. The fix diff 6e9cb9b7..36dec52e touches only check-review.sh and red-p2.log (git diff --exit-code over docs/, scenes/, bench/, and measure/tracks/ is empty). The fix adds a P2-d compare of the Judge critical cell and the judge route cell, a P2-c requirement for a labeled model_id or model_family line in each log, and a P2-c audited_head ancestor check that runs whenever a git HEAD resolves. Rerun results: adversarial-p2.sh exits 0 with the control at 34 of 34 and probes 01 critical flip, 02 judge cell, and 03 route-only log all CAUGHT, probes 04, 05, 07, 08 still CAUGHT, and probe 06 informational only because the /tmp fixture has no git HEAD. Probe 06's exposure is now caught on any real tree: R1 mutates the live vision-review-b1.json audited_head to deadbeef00000000000000000000000000000001 and check-review.sh fails with FAIL: P2-c batch b1 audited_head [...] is not an ancestor of HEAD (35 checks, PASS=34 FAIL=1), then the file is restored byte-identical (git diff --quiet exit 0) and the gate returns to 34 of 34. Three new probes against the new checks: R2 stores the batch critical as the string "true" and fails with 2 FAILs (the P2-b boolean type check plus the new P2-d Judge critical compare, both defenses firing on one mutation); R3 sets the mill judge cell to a different same-family route kimi-code-plan-cn/kimi-for-coding-v2 and fails on the exact P2-d route compare; R4 rewrites the b1 log to cite model_id: claude-sonnet-5-5 and PASSES, exposing one residual Nit: the labeled-line grep is presence-only and never compares the cited model with the batch route or family. The committed logs are true records (all four carry model_id: kimi-for-coding), so the residual gap is future drift only; route it to Red as a follow-up. One caveat recorded for Phase 3: adversarial-p2.sh probe 06 will keep printing DEFECT CONFIRMED (informational) inside its HEAD-less fixture by design; the real-tree ancestor defense is proven by R1, and any future checker regression on that branch must be re-probed on a tree with a git HEAD. This role fixed nothing and changed only its two run artifacts.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-4 [Nit] adversarial-testing: the new P2-c log check (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-review.sh:201-210 after commit 36dec52e) requires a labeled model_id or model_family line but never compares the cited value with the batch route or model family. Fixture proof: R4 rewrites the b1 log to the two lines route: kimi-code-plan-cn/kimi-for-coding and model_id: claude-sonnet-5-5, and the checker prints PASS: P2-c batch b1 log cites its route and a model id or family with exit 0 and 34 of 34. Rationale: a log that names a maker-family model as the judge passes the gate; the committed logs are true records (all four cite model_id: kimi-for-coding, verified by review-a and re-verified here with grep), so the exposure is future drift only, and the batch JSON route and model_family remain the primary checked records; Red can close it by requiring the model_id or model_family value to match the batch route or family, taking care not to reintroduce the substring vacuity that ADV-P2-03 exposed.
